en.text: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的罪过在他心里说：

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的罪過在他心裏說：

en.text: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, to detect and hate his sin.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

zhSimplified.text: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈；

zhTraditional.text: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐；

en.text: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天；

en.text: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！

en.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

zhSimplified.text: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足； 。

zhTraditional.text: 他們必因你殿裏的肥甘得以飽足； 。

en.text: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，在你那裏有生命的源頭；

en.text: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人，

zhTraditional.text: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人，

en.text: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. the hand of the wicked drive me away.

zhSimplified.text: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我；

zhTraditional.text: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我；

en.text: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒；

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏，作孽的人已經仆倒；
